item.title: NIF Board Vacant, Officer Killed, Dog Attack
item.ns0:title: NIF Board Vacant, Officer Killed, Dog Attack
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, major questions surround the National Investment Fund as Parliament prepares to return from summer recess following revelations that no active board is governing the fund. Heartbreak strikes the Royal Bahamas Police Force after a 37-year-old traffic division officer tragically succumbs to his injuries following a weekend collision. Task force crews move in to demolish illegal structures in a South New Providence shanty town, while a distraught mother speaks out after her three-year-old daughter is viciously attacked by a dog. Plus, we bring you details on a police officer facing attempted murder charges, an inside look at how the University of the Bahamas is preparing students for the future, and your complete sports and weather update.
